column1: # gc_unmapped_store_baseline.tsv -- the PER-WITNESS ratchet of the unmapped-store class (cto, row
# `util_gc_unmapped_store_census.py <witnesses> --write-baseline <this file>` in the landing that earns a move.
# ONE LINE PER WITNESS AND NEVER A TOTAL, on hq_snobol4's measurement of 2026-09-20: the population is a
# directory glob, so nine witnesses arriving would move a total from 162 to 192 and the arm would print THE
# CLASS GREW and name a compiler regression it never measured.  A witness ARRIVING is a file addition; a
# witness's own numbers MOVING is the thing this row exists to catch, and only a name set can tell them apart.
# THE FIFTH COLUMN IS THIS CENSUS'S OWN REACH (cto 2026-09-20): stores shielded at a safe point into a
# FIXED SYMBOL rather than into the frame.  It is ratcheted because shielding MOVING from the graded road
# to the unread one is a loss of coverage that every other number here reads as an improvement.

# RE-CUT 2026-09-24 cto, SCRIP this landing (the seventeen-red row, class B): 56 rows MOVED with shielded and unread_static UP everywhere and members unchanged -- since af1d0e856 every C call from emitted code writes r8/r10/r11 into the fixed symbol rtccb around the call (the RTX ABI's writebacks), which this census counts as stores shielded into a fixed symbol; the five polls landed the same day add record stores below the swept floor. Neither is a store that lost its map (members=0 on every moved row before and after). Four witness rows are NEW (hb_match_enter_subject_polled, hb_defer_close_after_a_deferred_capture_polled, hb_match_value_close_polled, hb_size_result_polled), the reach witnesses of the five polls; the population is the gate's own (icn, sno, pl, raku).

# RE-CUT 2026-09-26 cto, SCRIP this landing (row gc-the-unmapped-store-census-walks-back-through-the-inline-pending-test-of-ceo-1251-to-the-stores-the-poll-shields): the census was BLIND from af773a80e (CEO-1251, 2026-09-25 00:08: every poll behind an inline g_gc_pending test whose je stopped the backward walk) until this landing taught shielded_stores() the six-instruction preamble, so this re-cut spans two days of landings the ratchet could not read. 67 of 73 rows MOVED, 8 ARRIVED, none GONE; members UP on NO witness; the loss direction (shielded DOWN with unread_static UP) on NO witness. By language, net over the moved rows: Icon members -14 undecidable -8 shielded -2 unread_static -822 (24 rows moved in unread_static ONLY, every delta a multiple of 3, one poll bracket of three write-backs each -- two-tree count on hb_aggt.icn: the 09-24 tree 08236d07d emits 21 polls and 120 rtccb write-backs, HEAD 18 and 102, three polls fewer since the speed landings, so nine fewer static stores in the polls own blocks; nothing moved from the graded road); SNOBOL4 members -352 undecidable -58 shielded -410 unread_static -669 (fewer safe points after the 09-24/25 by-name speed landings; no row rose); Prolog members 0 undecidable +274 shielded +830 unread_static +1353 (more sites after hq_prolog landings, every one undecidable NO-ANCHOR-REACHES-SITE, no member); Raku unchanged on all 6 rows.

# RE-CUT 2026-09-27 cto, SCRIP this landing (the slim-road restore): six Prolog rows MOVED and nothing else, every one hq_prolog R7 (cc049b33f, 19:06, landed while this census was blind and after the 09-26 re-cut above was measured): is/2 carries two polls and every $ax_/$cmp_/type-test site derefs inline before its cold call, so undecidable UP (findall 282 -> 306, root_cells 256 -> 276, pldb 194 -> 214, batch_b 258 -> 282, reloc_gaps 96 -> 96, atom_dup 144 -> 152), shielded and unread_static UP with them, members 0 -> 0 on every row -- the same six rises R7 declared on gc_safe_point_contract_floor.tsv with the reader-limit reason (the anchor walk does not cross the deref loop back-edge, the contract row owes the walk). The 09-26 re-cut line above is preserved; Icon, SNOBOL4 and Raku rows unchanged.

# RE-CUT 2026-09-27 hq_icon, SCRIP this landing (the cto's bisect of two GC reds from the 09-27 Icon landings): ONE row MOVED, hb_sibling_frames_leave_no_dead_map_cell.icn shielded 122 -> 174 and unread_static 1419 -> 1536 with members 0 both times -- first bad 9778142aa (icon: a builtin whose global is assigned or swapped is called through that global), whose calls through a global add shielded stores and statics read, never an unmapped member; and ONE row ARRIVED, hb_icn_reversible_assignment_to_pos_and_subject.icn (added by 9df517aae with no baseline line), members 0. Arm (h) stays red by design at 622.

# RE-CUT 2026-10-04 cto, SCRIP this landing (the cfo's ruling of 2026-10-04 on the coo's bisect of the arm (e) move to c869d57c1): the census now names the ARCH-GC 6.5b result cell (sub rsp,16 / two stores / call rt_gc_poll / two loads / add rsp,16) on its own SPILL-6.5B lines and counts it in neither members nor shielded; with that, the new census reads IDENTICAL rows on c869d57c1 and on its parent over the ten Icon witnesses that grew (result-cell polls 5 -> 598), so that landing's whole move was the result cell. Against the 2026-09-27 rows: members rose in NO witness and fell in 38 (622 -> 342 over the 82 rows: the old count held the result cells of the poll forms that already used the shape); undecidable rose in 10 Icon witnesses, bisected with the new census on hb_bignum_length.icn (0 -> 100) to b1bee0c53 (hq_icon, THE BLOCK PROTOCOL: callee frames entered by an indirect jump no anchored prologue reaches, the census's declared NO-ANCHOR-REACHES-SITE limit), carried to landing 1 of the chain over the maps, which must re-anchor this census anyway because it anchors each frame at the map-cell store that landing deletes; shielded and unread_static drifted both ways over the week's landings (counts of stores examined, not members) and were not bisected per row; the 19 witnesses that arrived since 2026-09-27 are added.
